title: Primary garden area for lots coded R100-SL (Table 2.10a)
text: Table 2.10a Modified provisions for housing on lots less than 100m2. 1.1 Private open space | C1.1.1 | Dwellings to provide: - a single consolidated uncovered primary garden area with a minimum area of 15m2 and a minimum dimension of 3m;

replaces.note: current R100-SL source not confirmed from the register

source.file: Residential Design Codes Chapter 3 - Grouped Dwellings.pdf

verified.note: Values clear (15m2, 3m, uncovered). Clauses column cites C1.1.1, which in Chapter 3 is the OLA clause; the PGA clause is C1.1.3 (drafting error, no effect on values).

notes: Table 2.10a (Chapter 3 p26; grouped dwellings in R100-SL subject to C2.10.1) replaces Table 1.1b: a single consolidated UNCOVERED PGA of 15 m2 with a 3 m minimum dimension, one composite. Uncovered encoded as roofed_pct <= 0. Table 2.10a lists the clause as 'C1.1.1' although the PGA clause is C1.1.3. Same as the Chapter 2 twin. Two-column extract.
